title: Gatchalian disputes P25M daily cost of Sara Duterte impeachment trial

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Wednesday disputed the claim that the Senate is spending P25 million daily in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, saying the amount represented the operating costs of the entire chamber. According to Gatchalian, “The claim that the impeachment trial costs the Senate P25 million a day is completely untrue.” In a statement dated Oct. 14, the Senate president said expenses directly attributable to the trial totaled P14,553,561.70 over 44 trial days, or an average of about P330,763 per day.
